author: smitdalt
body:
Hey guys! After 75-ish videos, I finally hit 100 subscribers! :D It honestly isn't that many subs, but it's a start for me. I've been having a really great time so far making videos and hope to grow my channel even more. If you have any game/video ideas for me please leave a comment either here or on the video. Thanks!

100 subscriber video: http://youtu.be/9bcBXnBrPU4

(Special thanks to Gummi3 / mhanif62 for being my 100th sub!)
